title: Cells and Tissues in Action
summary: Grade 9: organelles and their jobs, diffusion and osmosis, plant tissues, animal tissues, and the muscles, bones and joints that move us.

ib.statementOfInquiry: The form of each cell and tissue suits its function, and tissues working together as systems keep an organism alive.

factual: What are the four types of animal tissue?
conceptual: How does the structure of a tissue suit its function?
Why do plant cells not burst in water, while animal cells can?
debatable: Should schools require daily physical activity to build bone and muscle health?
